releaseNote.summary: Nested SubFlow start chains skip the no-op settle, the discarded parent re-read and the separate settlement-marker write; long-poll resumes are counted and logged by trigger (ack vs fallback).

startSubflowHandoffSettleElision.description: An intermediate level of a nested SubFlow start chain (identity-only caller, post-commit jobs all StartSubflowJob) no longer takes the status lock, reloads the parent and commits an empty transaction in PostCommit.Settle: the hop that entered the SubFlow state was marked terminal, so no status was deferred and the settle could flip nothing, schedule nothing and publish nothing (TransitionRunner.IsSettleFreeStartSubflowHandoff, the start-chain twin of the forward relay's IsSettleFreeForwardRelay). StartSubflowJobHandler also drops its sync-caller re-read of the parent into ClientResponse, which nothing read after the barrier. The client-facing root still settles from the authoritative reload. Measured on morph-idm zeebe-approval (test, 2026-11-03): nine settles of 58 ms average and four re-reads of ~100 ms in one depth-4 start request. The awaiting span carries vnext.settle.skipped=true.

longPollResumeObservability.description: A pipeline paused for declarative long-poll termination resumes either because the client posted longpoll/ack or because the fallbackTimeoutSeconds job fired; the two used to share one log line (20301) and no metric. LongPoll.AckResume now carries vnext.activation.trigger (ack | ack-timeout), the counter workflow_longpoll_resume_total (meter BBT.Workflow.Telemetry; tags vnext.domain, vnext.flow.key, vnext.activation.trigger, vnext.longpoll.ack_resume.outcome) counts every resume request, and a fallback-driven resume logs LongPollFallbackResumed (20308) instead of LongPollAckResumed (20301). A flow whose ack-timeout count tracks its resumed count has a client that never acknowledges and pays the whole window on every instance (morph-idm approval, test: 36 of 36).

subflowResumeStampsSettlementMarker.description: SubflowCompletionService used to open one more unit of work after the parent's resume for a single set-based UPDATE (InstanceCorrelation.SettledAt, the duplicate-delivery fast-path marker). The completion relay now hands the terminal outcome to the resume (ExecutionInfo.SubFlowResumeTerminalOutcome / SubFlowResumeSettledAt, mirrored on PipelineDirectives) and ClearBusyOnResumeStep stamps the marker inside the resume hop's own unit of work; the meaning is unchanged (the parent's resume reached the database) and a resume that fails afterwards still reverts the correlation, which clears the marker. The separate best-effort write remains only for a resume that stopped before its first step (AutoTransitionConditionNotMet, InstanceCompleted). One fewer DbContext, connection rental and round trip per completion; measured on morph-idm zeebe-approval (test, 2026-11-03) five such writes per ack-timeout chain.
